title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Layer Cake
description: Manon's layer-cake architecture organizes all knowledge into chip-like layers: L0 raw observations, L1 calibrated measurements, L2 derived quantities, L3 models, L4 narratives — each layer addressable, versioned, and recomputable from the layer below. The honest claim is organizational, not physical: it is a way to stack knowledge so nothing floats ungrounded. Every record in this database declares its layer. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: Addressable Facts
description: Manon's addressable-facts scheme gives every fact a deterministic address from its content hash — the same fact always lands at the same address, duplicates collapse automatically, and citations become pointers. It is modeled on content-addressed storage (like IPFS) applied to knowledge: argue with a fact and you argue with its address. The scheme makes 'have we recorded this already' a lookup, not a debate. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Compression Tiers
description: Manon's compression tiers store knowledge at four resolutions: headline (one sentence), brief (one paragraph), full (the complete record), and source (raw data + provenance) — with every tier derivable downward on demand. A phone on a slow connection gets headlines; a researcher gets sources. Nothing is ever stored only as a summary: the full tier is the ground truth. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: Provenance Chains
description: Manon's provenance chains require every derived fact to carry its derivation recipe — inputs, operations, software versions — so any number in the index can be re-walked to its observations. 'A fact you cannot re-derive is a rumor with formatting.' The chain is stored alongside the fact, not in a separate document nobody reads. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Disagreement Register
description: Manon's disagreement register files scientific disputes as first-class records: the competing values, who holds them, what evidence each cites, and what observation would settle it. The Hubble tension gets an entry, not a footnote. The register's rule is that the index never picks a winner silently — disagreement is data about the state of knowledge. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: Time-Stamped Truth
description: Manon's time-stamped truth principle versions every fact: 'as of 2026, the count is X' rather than 'the count is X' — because counts change and undated facts rot into falsehoods. The index never overwrites; it appends new versions and keeps the history. A reader can ask what the index believed in any year and get an honest answer. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Ignorance Map
description: Manon's ignorance map charts what the index does NOT know — open questions sized by importance, with borders showing which are approachable and which are walled by physics. Dark matter's identity gets a large territory; the universe's exact topology gets a distant one. The map's purpose is strategic: fund and think where the map is biggest and most approachable. title: Signature Chip Architecture: Cross-Domain Bridges

The architecture treats analogies as infrastructure, not decoration — but labels them analogies, never identities. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Wonder Budget
description: Manon's wonder budget reserves index space for the unexplained-but-real: fast radio bursts' origins, the Wow! signal, ʻOumuamua's acceleration — filed as 'genuine mysteries' with evidence quality scores, neither debunked nor hyped. The budget caps at 1% of the index so mystery never crowds out knowledge, and every entry carries the experiment that could resolve it. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Human Layer
description: Manon's human layer insists the index keep who measured what and when: Rubin's rotation curves, Hubble's classification, Penzias and Wilson's static. Science is done by people, and stripping their names turns discoveries into weather. The layer also records instruments and their limits, because every measurement is a negotiation between nature and apparatus. Signature concept.

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Scale Slider

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Error Confessional

title: Signature Chip Architecture: The One-Page Universe
description: Manon's one-page universe is the index's ultimate compression test: the entire observable universe summarized on a single page — scales, counts, timeline, open questions — with every line linking to its full record. title: Signature Chip Architecture: The Living Index Oath
description: Manon's living-index oath is the constitution of the chip architecture, recited by its maintainers: update when the world changes, never silently; label hypothesis as hypothesis; keep the ignorance map honest; credit the measurers; and when in doubt, show the disagreement. The oath is the only part of the architecture that is moral rather than technical — and the part everything else depends on. Signature concept.
